cause: MarkupSafe 2.1.0 removed soft_unicode, which Jinja2 2.x still imports.
fix: Upgrade Jinja2 to 3.x (pip install 'jinja2>=3'). If something pins Jinja2 2.x, pin MarkupSafe below 2.1 instead: pip install 'markupsafe<2.1'.

symptom: Error: error:0308010C:digital envelope routines::unsupported (webpack build on Node 17 or newer)
cause: Node 17+ ships OpenSSL 3, which disables the MD4 hash that webpack 4 uses for module hashing.
fix: Upgrade to webpack 5 (or a toolchain built on it). As a stopgap, run the build with NODE_OPTIONS=--openssl-legacy-provider.

symptom: Error: pg_config executable not found. (pip install psycopg2)
cause: psycopg2 builds from source and needs the PostgreSQL client headers and pg_config, which aren't installed.
fix: Install psycopg2-binary for development, or install the libpq development package first (Debian/Ubuntu: apt install libpq-dev; macOS: brew install libpq) and retry. New code can use psycopg 3: pip install 'psycopg[binary]'.
repro: pip install psycopg2==2.9.9  # on a machine without libpq headers
